subject.title: Gateway: preserve approved scope baseline during pairing

question: Should OpenClaw change the documented direct-local fresh device pairing default from silent auto-approval to explicit approval for shared-auth operator devices?
rationale: This is an auth-boundary and compatibility decision: the PR tightens fresh local pairing, while current docs and related maintainer discussion preserve local first-pairing auto-approval and rely on explicit approval only for later widening.

options.title: Keep local first-pairing auto-approval
options.body: Preserve current behavior and close or rework this PR into a narrower non-breaking hardening path.

options.title: Adopt explicit fresh local approval
options.body: Accept the stricter local pairing model, but require docs, migration/upgrade proof, and current-main rebase before merge.

options.title: Pause for Gateway auth owner
options.body: Leave the draft open until the Gateway auth owner chooses the permanent local trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep local first-pairing auto-approval
recommendation.body: Preserve current behavior and close or rework this PR into a narrower non-breaking hardening path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent Gateway locality/auth changes and have recent maintainer-side decision context in the same pairing boundary.
